picks.title: Isaiah 13-35: Isaiah Foresees the Apostasy and Restoration
picks.summary:
What do you do when the world around you seems to be spinning into chaos, noise, and spiritual deception? In Isaiah 13–35, the prophet looks past the rising superpowers of his day to deliver a sweeping message for our modern world: Babylon will fall, but Zion will stand! If you have ever felt overwhelmed by the weight of the last days, this masterclass reveals why you can hang every hope upon the Savior and know that He will hold.
Summary: In this deep dive into Isaiah 13–35, we walk through the profound prophetic chapters that Nephi loved, lived, and quoted throughout the Book of Mormon. Movi
picks.reason: Isaiah's prophecy on apostasy and restoration offers hope amid end-times challenges.

picks.title: Jeff Strong, Part 1: Why People Leave the Church
picks.summary:
When Jeff Strong’s missionary son decided to come home and step away from the Church, it forced Jeff to confront questions he had already begun seeing in the lives of people around him.
In Part 1 of our conversation with the author of Torn, we talk about what his research uncovered about why active Latter-day Saints leave, how those reasons have changed over time, and why Jeff believes Church culture can either soften those struggles or make them much harder.

picks.reason: Research-based conversation on why Latter-day Saints leave the church.

picks.title: Isaiah 1-12: Great Are the Words of Isaiah
picks.summary:
The Savior commanded us to search the words of Isaiah with diligence, declaring that "great are the words of Isaiah". Yet for so many readers, Isaiah feels like a locked door or a foreign language. If you’ve ever felt intimidated by the poetic imagery, the rapid shifts in tone, or the complex geopolitical history, Isaiah 1–12 provides the ultimate key to unlock the entire book.

picks.reason: In-depth study unlocking Isaiah's words with restoration insights.
